# MrW Overlay for POE 2 v2.19.0

## What's new

- **Map loot sessions:** the tracker's Map loot tab lists your maps session by session, newest first, each with its own figures (time, time in maps and in the hideout, loot per map and per hour, best map, what came in most). The current session stays open at the top; older ones open with a click.
- **Session cost and net:** set what went into a session (waystones, tablets…) in div or ex to see its net. The box over the game can show the net too.
- **Name, merge, delete:** name a session, merge it with the one before, or delete it together with its maps.
- **Sessions on their own:** a new session starts when the game is opened after being closed for an hour or more; after a shorter close, such as a crash, the session goes on and the closed time does not count. "Start a new session" still starts one at any time.
- **Faster start:** the game's log is read on from where the app stopped, so the app no longer reads back through it each time it starts. Maps kept before this version stay under "Earlier maps".

MrW Overlay is built by a player, for players. It is not an official Grinding Gear Games product, and they don't back it.

## Updating

On v1.8.0 or later, update from Settings → **Updates**. Your filter settings, profiles, saved searches and pathofexile.com connection are kept. The Microsoft Store version updates through the Store.

## Install

The release file is `poe2filtre-windows-amd64.exe`. It is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you: **More info → Run anyway**. Or get it from the Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PM376D3LFBG
